preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, int) and 1 <= t <= 1000 for t in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 50 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each of the t subsequent lines is a string s of length 1 ≤ |s| ≤ 50, consisting of Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'Yes', 'yes', 'NO', 'No', 'no']) and (stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'Yes', 'yes'] if any(s == ''.join(['Yes'[j % 3] for j in range(len(s))]) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:][i]]) else stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['NO', 'No', 'no']) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, output 'YES' (case-insensitive) if s is a substring of an infinite repetition of 'Yes' (i.e., 'YesYesYes...'), otherwise output 'NO'. The substring check must respect the exact cyclic pattern of 'Yes' (i.e., s must match a contiguous sequence of characters from 'YesYesYes...').
